criteria.name: identity_and_source_backed_footprint
criteria.rationale: Current official operator page identifies Joyful Journey at 600 Lindberg Road, northwest corner of Lindberg/Salisbury, and invites visitors to tour the house; the 2019 Area IV guide image shows the entry number 600. OSM way 869182111 carries the matching name/address and its 12-point roof-perimeter outline registers visually on the saved Esri aerial. The OSM outline is a crowd-mapped roof-edge proxy, not survey-quality wall geometry; model agreement with it is not independent geodetic proof.

criteria.name: position_orientation_and_dimensions
criteria.rationale: Fresh-open geometry remains in campus coordinates with identity transform and world bounds X[-104.04565,-65.91480], Y[2056.23877,2078.08032], Z[0,8.76000] m. These XY values correspond to the OSM ring/project conversion, and the roof overlay places it on the same property. Bearing and 38.13 x 21.84 m envelope are based on the OSM roof proxy and approximate local transform; no survey control is available.

criteria.name: height_levels_and_roof
criteria.rationale: The 2019 image supports a front gable with upper-level windows; aerial imagery supports a multi-facet pitched roof. Eave 5.4 m, roof peak 8.7 m, and two above-grade levels are photo-scaled estimates, not measured elevations or verified floor count. Exact ridge breaks and roof pitch remain uncertain.

criteria.name: facade_entrances_and_materials
criteria.rationale: The model depicts muted green-gray siding, light window/roof trim, dark red-brown shutters, upper gable windows, and a covered entry, matching visible cues in the labeled 2019 photo. Materials are solid-color node shaders rather than surface-textured siding/roof/masonry. The reference also shows stone at the entry, a porch rail/columns, and a richer facade; these are omitted or simplified, and unpictured elevations are schematic.

criteria.name: technical_export_portability_and_evidence
criteria.rationale: Blender 5.2.3 fresh-open confirms the stable scene/collection and one mesh object (886 vertices/218 faces), identity transform, no modifiers, no linked libraries, and no external texture dependencies. Seven node materials are assigned. The prior independent r2 grade was also 8.0/10 and the exact binary SHA is now verified. At assessment time the shared manifest still recorded Z max 16.0 m; the coordinator subsequently corrected it to 8.7600002289 m, matching the exact saved candidate maximum. The asset remains directly linked in campus coordinates. No interior is modeled; no reliable interior plan was located in reviewed evidence.
